title: Verify prompt-cache preservation and incremental request shape
objective: Measure cacheability proxies and request diffs to prove catalog changes append at the tail rather than invalidating stable prefixes.
context: Complete one low-conflict slice of the accepted live skill catalog and cache-preserving design.
The worktree is shared and dirty; only owned_files may be modified.

source_evidence.note: Developer-context initial catalog and progressive disclosure inspiration.
Live discovery, visibility overrides, and skill lifecycle inspiration.

include: Compare serialized request sequences byte-for-byte up to the prior prefix.
Assert unchanged system blocks, tools, model settings, and PromptCacheKey.
Assert no-change yields zero delta and Responses incremental paths send only appended items.
Add bounded benchmarks for large catalogs.
exclude: Do not claim real vendor cache-hit percentages from local tests.

implementation_steps: Capture initial, unchanged, add, update, revoke, and compact request shapes.
Calculate stable-prefix length and appended bytes.
Benchmark rendering/diffing at representative catalog sizes.
acceptance_criteria: Pre-compact catalog changes preserve the entire prior request prefix.
Only delta and current user content are new.
Compact is explicitly reported as a one-time prefix rebuild.
Results are labeled cacheability evidence, not provider billing evidence.
dispatch_prompt: Add cacheability/request-shape acceptance tests and benchmarks only. Prove stable prefix behavior without claiming live provider cache-hit rates.
notes_for_assignee: If verification exposes a defect in another owner's production file, report the exact failing test and owner task; do not patch across ownership boundaries.
